rows.grounds: numeral element forming the compound number with sahasreṣu
locative plural indicating the vast number in which torment occurs
compound yoni+yantra denoting generative mechanisms or matrices
past passive participle describing the afflicted state of beings

items.question: What condition afflicts beings within the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams?
premises: The scope is eighty-four thousand in number.
The locus of affliction is the womb-diagrams.
Beings in that locus are described as tormented.
items.inference: Beings are subject to torment throughout the vast multiplicity of generative womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The subject of pīḍitāḥ is not explicitly named in this verse and is inferred from context.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
